requirement.evidence:
The LAD also prohibits housing discrimination  based
on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent
or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses.

status.evidence:
The LAD also prohibits housing discrimination  based
on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent
or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses.
status.note: Document presents the rule as current law; no effective date needed.

coverage.evidence:
The rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family
dwelling, the other occupancy unit of which is occupied
by the owner as his/her residence at the time of such
rentals;
coverage.note: The owner-occupied two-family exemption exists, but the document does not frame it as a unit maximum of 2. It also omits the one-family room-rental and other exemptions. The card's number is a loose paraphrase.

citation.evidence:
The Division on Civil Rights enforces the New Jersey
Law Against Discrimination.
citation.note: The document names the LAD, but gives no statute section for the source-of-income provision. The citation is only a general name.
